# OpenAI

Apify integrates with [OpenAI](https://openai.com) across ChatGPT (via the Apify MCP server), Codex (in the ChatGPT desktop app and the CLI), the Agents SDK, and the legacy Assistants API. Each gives OpenAI models a way to call Apify Actors as tools and read their results.

## What you can build

https://docs.apify.com/integrations/chatgpt.md

#### [ChatGPT](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/chatgpt.md)

[Use Apify as an MCP server inside ChatGPT. Ask ChatGPT to run Actors and pull live web data into the conversation.](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/chatgpt.md)

https://docs.apify.com/integrations/codex-app.md

#### [Codex (desktop app)](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/codex-app.md)

https://docs.apify.com/integrations/codex-cli.md

#### [Codex CLI](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/codex-cli.md)

[Install the Apify plugin for Codex in your terminal to discover, run, and build Actors through the Apify MCP server.](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/codex-cli.md)

https://docs.apify.com/integrations/openai-agents.md

#### [OpenAI Agents SDK](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/openai-agents.md)
